# Oleg Cherkas

> Oleg Cherkas and his team build and run LinkedIn and email outbound for B2B founders, technology companies and professional service firms, turning a defined ideal customer profile into qualified business conversations. Markets: the GCC, Singapore, the UK, Malaysia and Australia.
